name: Confirmation Bias
axiom: People seek and weight evidence that confirms what they already believe.
trigger: A dashboard shows only the runs that support the current plan.

checklist.text: Show disconfirming results at the same prominence as confirming ones.
Ask what evidence would change the decision before the test runs.
Record every run, including the ones that refute the hypothesis.

antiPattern.violation: Only successful test runs are shown, so a failing design looks proven.
antiPattern.remediation: Report all runs, with refutations beside the successes.

parametricParams.caption: CONFIRMING EVIDENCE GETS THE FIRST LOOK

academicOrigin.title: Confirmation Bias: A Ubiquitous Phenomenon in Many Guises
